svg.aria-label: Accuracy digits of two finite-difference formulas against step size h
svg.title: Accuracy digits of two finite-difference formulas against step size h

text.tspan: Finite differences: the step size h trades two errors
bar height = accurate digits, -log10(error); taller is better
large h: truncation error; tiny h: round-off error (about 1e-16 relative)
